BRANCH = 'main'
FILES = [
    'backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts',
    'backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.test.ts',
]
COMMIT_MESSAGE = 'fix(router): classify senior-level knowledge questions as LLM_TEXT_RESPONSE — prevents debugging/performance/trade-off/ownership prompts from falling into clarification bucket'

print("=" * 70)
print("  DEPLOYING FIX VIA GITHUB API")
print("=" * 70)

def gh_api(path, method='GET', body=None):
    url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}{path}'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None, method=method)
    req.add_header('Authorization', f'Bearer {TOKEN}')
    req.add_header('Accept', 'application/vnd.github+json')
    req.add_header('User-Agent', 'ivx-deploy')
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
        return resp.getcode(), json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode()
        try: return e.code, json.loads(raw)
        except: return e.code, {'error': raw}

# 1. Get current HEAD

    print(f"ERROR: Could not get HEAD: {code} {head}")
    exit(1)

print(f"  Base tree:     {base_tree_sha[:12]}")

    with open(f, 'rb') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    encoded = base64.b64encode(content).decode()
    code, blob = gh_api('/git/blobs', 'POST', {
        'content': encoded,
        'encoding': 'base64'
    })
    if code != 201:
        print(f"ERROR creating blob for {f}: {code} {blob}")
        exit(1)
    file_blobs.append({'path': f, 'sha': blob['sha'], 'mode': '100644', 'type': 'blob'})
    print(f"  {f}: blob {blob['sha'][:12]} ({len(content)} bytes)")

# 3. Create new tree
print("\n[3] Creating new tree...")
code, tree = gh_api('/git/trees', 'POST', {
    'base_tree': base_tree_sha,
    'tree': file_blobs
})
if code != 201:
    print(f"ERROR creating tree: {code} {tree}")
    exit(1)
new_tree_sha = tree['sha']
print(f"  New tree: {new_tree_sha[:12]}")

# 4. Create commit
print("\n[4] Creating commit...")
code, commit = gh_api('/git/commits', 'POST', {
    'message': COMMIT_MESSAGE,
    'tree': new_tree_sha,
    'parents': [parent_sha]
})
if code != 201:
    print(f"ERROR creating commit: {code} {commit}")
    exit(1)
new_commit_sha = commit['sha']
print(f"  New commit: {new_commit_sha[:12]}")

# 5. Update reference
print("\n[5] Updating main branch reference...")
code, ref = gh_api(f'/git/refs/heads/{BRANCH}', 'PATCH', {
    'sha': new_commit_sha,
    'force': False
})
if code != 200:
    print(f"ERROR updating ref: {code} {ref}")
    exit(1)
print(f"  Updated {BRANCH} to {new_commit_sha[:12]}")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print(f"  DEPLOYED TO GITHUB: {new_commit_sha[:12]}")
print(f"  Render will auto-deploy from {BRANCH}")
print("=" * 70)

with open('/tmp/last_deploy_sha.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_commit_sha)
PYEOF
